title: Forced Shadows of an Obstructed Hyperbolic Kac-Moody Denominator
summary: The four orders of the quaternion algebra B6 carry four reflective wall data on lattices of signature (3,2); three integrate to Borcherds denominators and one is obstructed. The failed denominator survives as a weakly harmonic Maass form, and we prove its shadow is a Hecke eigenform on the line of the newform 6.4.a.a, with zero twist component.
